description: Overview The SPECTRONA 2026 Hackathon is a problem-solving competition where participants work in teams to develop practical technology-based solutions to given problem statements. Date: 22–24 October 2026 Venue: National Forensic Sciences University, Guwahati Organised by: NFSU Guwahati Who Can Participate? Students from colleges and universities. Inter-college and inter-disciplinary teams may participate. Team size will be as per the final guidelines. Hackathon Format Participants will receive problem statements and work on a technology-based solution, prototype or demonstrable project, followed by a presentation before the judges. Evaluation Projects may be evaluated on: Problem understanding Innovation Technical implementation Practical feasibility Quality of solution Presentation and demonstration General Rules Participants must follow the official hackathon rules and code of conduct. Submitted work must comply with the eligibility and submission guidelines. Plagiarism or violation of rules may result in disqualification. The decision of the judging panel and organising committee will be final. Note: Problem statements, team size, schedule, submission process and detailed judging criteria will be announced by the organising team.

raw.details:
Overview

The SPECTRONA 2026 Hackathon is a problem-solving competition where participants work in teams to develop practical technology-based solutions to given problem statements.

  • Date: 22–24 October 2026
  • Venue: National Forensic Sciences University, Guwahati
  • Organised by: NFSU Guwahati

Who Can Participate?

  • Students from colleges and universities.
  • Inter-college and inter-disciplinary teams may participate.
  • Team size will be as per the final guidelines.

Hackathon Format

Participants will receive problem statements and work on a technology-based solution, prototype or demonstrable project, followed by a presentation before the judges.

Evaluation

Projects may be evaluated on:

  • Problem understanding
  • Innovation
  • Technical implementation
  • Practical feasibility
  • Quality of solution
  • Presentation and demonstration

General Rules

  • Participants must follow the official hackathon rules and code of conduct.
  • Submitted work must comply with the eligibility and submission guidelines.
  • Plagiarism or violation of rules may result in disqualification.
  • The decision of the judging panel and organising committee will be final.

Note: Problem statements, team size, schedule, submission process and detailed judging criteria will be announced by the organising team.
